title: Studio: the disabled Publish button ("No drafts pending publish") is unreachable by keyboard and shows no hover reason, unlike the read-only Publish state beside it
body:
qa#1 · zhuangjianguo · session_01QsR2jUARzLeR7GhKms8a5s

QA-source: #31486 · ux-conventions.disabled-control-reason · observed beside the clauses

Found off-clause by the QA run #31486 (subject `0647dabb`). Measured on 2 fresh loads, and once on the showcase after `ensure-customization` created its pair package.

## Reproduction

1. Create a writable package: `POST /api/v1/packages {"manifest":{"id":"com.qa.pubprobe","name":"QA Pub Probe","version":"0.1.0","type":"app","namespace":"qapp"}}`.
2. Open `/_console/studio/com.qa.pubprobe/data` with no drafts.
3. The header Publish button: native `disabled`, with `title` and `aria-describedby` "No drafts pending publish" on the button itself; no focusable wrapper, no `[role=tooltip]` on hover, skipped by Tab.

Expected: the same treatment as the read-only Publish state: a focusable wrapper whose tooltip and accessible description give the reason.

## Mechanism

`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/StudioDesignSurface.tsx`: `publishButton` (around lines 1503–1545, `disabled={publishing || !hasPending || publishReadOnly}`, `title` only when not read-only), and around lines 1684–1722 the focusable Tooltip wrapper is drawn only when `publishReadOnly`. The "no drafts" state keeps the title-on-a-disabled-button pattern that the read-only branch's own comment (objectui#12303) calls unreachable.

Owning package: `@object-ui/app-shell`. Full evidence: #31486, slice C3b.
